<script>
/* Wall videos. Playback starts here, never from markup: only when on screen, never under
   reduced motion, and never after the visitor pressed Pause. Without JS the poster shows. */
(function () {
  var vids = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.wall video'));
  if (!vids.length) return;
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var held = false, onScreen = new Set();
  var apply = function () {
    vids.forEach(function (v) {
      if (!mq.matches && !held && onScreen.has(v)) { var p = v.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {}); }
      else { v.pause(); }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.vid-toggle').forEach(function (b) {
      b.hidden = mq.matches;
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', held ? 'true' : 'false');
      b.firstChild.nodeValue = held ? 'Play' : 'Pause';
    });
  };
  document.querySelectorAll('.vid-toggle').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () { held = !held; apply(); });
  });
  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', apply); else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(apply);
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) onScreen.add(e.target); else onScreen.delete(e.target); });
      apply();
    }, { threshold: 0.15 });
    vids.forEach(function (v) { io.observe(v); });
  } else { vids.forEach(function (v) { onScreen.add(v); }); apply(); }
})();
</script>
